definition: to stop water from coming out of a pipe or roof
exampleSentence: We need someone to fix a leak in the roof.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi cần người sửa chỗ dột trên mái.

definition: to repair a tap that does not work properly
exampleSentence: My uncle came to fix the tap.
exampleTranslation: Chú tôi đến sửa vòi nước.

definition: to clear what is stopping water from flowing out of the sink
exampleSentence: I had to unblock the sink with a plunger.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải thông tắc bồn rửa bằng cây thụt.

definition: to remove what is blocking a drain
exampleSentence: He unclogged the drain with a wire.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy thông cống thoát nước bằng một sợi dây thép.

definition: to put a new bulb in a lamp
exampleSentence: It took five minutes to change a light bulb.
exampleTranslation: Thay một cái bóng đèn mất năm phút.

definition: to put a new battery in a device
exampleSentence: I need to replace the battery in this clock.
exampleTranslation: Tôi cần thay pin cho chiếc đồng hồ này.

definition: to put new batteries in a device
exampleSentence: Change the batteries in the remote control.
exampleTranslation: Thay pin cho cái điều khiển từ xa đi.

definition: to make a hole in a wall with a drill
exampleSentence: Drill a hole in the wall for the screw.
exampleTranslation: Khoan một lỗ trên tường để bắt vít.

definition: to hit a nail with a hammer
exampleSentence: He hammered a nail into the wall.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy đóng một cây đinh vào tường.

definition: to turn a screw into wood or a wall
exampleSentence: Screw in a screw at each corner.
exampleTranslation: Vặn một con vít ở mỗi góc.

definition: to turn a screw so it is firm
exampleSentence: This chair is loose. Tighten a screw.
exampleTranslation: Cái ghế này lỏng rồi. Siết lại cái vít đi.

definition: to cover a wall with paint
exampleSentence: We painted the wall light blue.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi sơn tường màu xanh nhạt.

definition: to cover the walls of a room with paint
exampleSentence: It took two days to paint the room.
exampleTranslation: Sơn xong căn phòng mất hai ngày.

definition: to stick wallpaper on a wall
exampleSentence: She put up wallpaper in the bedroom.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy dán giấy dán tường trong phòng ngủ.

definition: to repair a door that does not close well
exampleSentence: I will fix the door tomorrow.
exampleTranslation: Ngày mai tôi sẽ sửa cửa.

definition: to put oil on the metal part that lets a door move
exampleSentence: Oil the hinge to stop the door squeaking.
exampleTranslation: Tra dầu vào bản lề để cửa hết kêu cọt kẹt.

definition: to turn off the electric power
exampleSentence: Switch off the electricity before you touch the wires.
exampleTranslation: Hãy ngắt điện trước khi chạm vào dây.

definition: to ask a plumber to come and repair pipes
exampleSentence: We called a plumber because the pipe was leaking.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi gọi thợ sửa ống nước vì ống bị rò.

definition: to ask an electrician to come and repair the electricity
exampleSentence: The lights keep going out. Let's call an electrician.
exampleTranslation: Đèn cứ tắt hoài. Mình gọi thợ điện đi.

definition: to stop the water from flowing
exampleSentence: Turn off the water before you fix the pipe.
exampleTranslation: Khóa nước trước khi sửa ống.

definition: to open a tap so water comes out
exampleSentence: Turn on the tap and wash your hands.
exampleTranslation: Mở vòi nước rồi rửa tay.

definition: to let water flow from a tap
exampleSentence: Run the tap until the water is hot.
exampleTranslation: Mở vòi cho nước chảy đến khi nước nóng.

definition: to put the parts of furniture together
exampleSentence: It took us all day to assemble the furniture.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi mất cả ngày để lắp ráp đồ nội thất.

definition: to do what the instructions tell you to do
exampleSentence: Follow the instructions carefully.
exampleTranslation: Hãy làm theo hướng dẫn thật cẩn thận.

definition: to put a new fuse in a plug or box
exampleSentence: I had to replace a fuse in the plug.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phải thay cầu chì trong phích cắm.
